thread:
anna-partnerships: Quick sync — vendors sent updated timelines; we need to choreograph availability, marketplace listings, and SI handoffs. Pinged legal/ops. Link: https://redwood.internal/rdw/hw-roadmap-jan

mike-hw: Heads-up from vendors: H100 restock ETA ~2025-01-12 (partial), H200 prototypes expected early Feb, MI300 volume shipments late Jan, Gaudi samples week of Jan 8 with ramp through Feb. These are vendor ETAs, not commitments. Region slates: EU/APAC may lag ~2–3 weeks.

javier-si: For SI integration we'll need final images + kernel patches at least 3w before GA for validation runs and perf tuning. Request: early sample access for our SI partners (NDA in place). Also need thermal/BIOS firmware when samples ship.

sarah-ops: Operational constraints: Dedicated clusters will require machine images updated for Gaudi (libgomp + ROCm variants) and MI300 (kernel 6.x). Plan two QA passes: smoke + full perf run. Can we get lab capacity w/c Jan 15? :calendar: 

ethan-legal: Please hold any press copy until partner sign-off. We require 72h review for joint announcements and embargo waivers. Also flag any customer-specific callouts — need redaction. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: calendar invite created by anna-partnerships — "HW vendor choreography — announcement & cadence" 2025-01-07 10:00 PT. Attendees: anna-partnerships, mike-hw, javier-si, sarah-ops, ethan-legal.

mike-hw: To be concrete on cadence options: Option A = staggered marketplace listings per-region as hardware becomes available (low risk, slower signal). Option B = single global marketplace wave with limited GA per-region (bigger PR impact, needs embargo alignment). Which do we prefer?

anna-partnerships: I lean Option A for reliability; Option B only if vendors guarantee sync and legal signs off. Thoughts from marketing on PR signal? :loudspeaker: 

sarah-ops: Ops preference = Option A. Allows us to gate Dedicated capacity and avoid overload. Also reduces customer support churn.

javier-si: SI preference = Option A but with a bridging dev image we can pre-release to SI partners for integration testing (label as "pre-GA SI build").

ethan-legal: We'll draft an embargo checklist. If Option B chosen, escalate review timeline to 5 business days. Option A = standard 72h.

anna-partnerships: Action items — mike-hw to confirm hard ETAs with vendors (due 1712410000), javier-si to compile SI partner list + NDA status (due 1712380000), sarah-ops to reserve lab nodes and image baseline (due 1712390000), ethan-legal to share embargo checklist doc (link to be posted). I'll coordinate marketplace listing templates. :thumbsup: 

mike-hw: Ack. I'll ping vendor PMs now and post updates in this thread.

javier-si: I'll start outreach to SI leads, will add a short matrix of who needs early images.

sarah-ops: Reserving 12 nodes in lab for Jan 15–31 window. Note: if Gaudi arrives earlier we'll accelerate.

ethan-legal: Drafted embargo checklist: https://redwood.internal/legal/embargo-checklist — sharing in #partners-docs as well.

anna-partnerships: Thanks — will follow up in meeting. If anyone sees a hard blocker (firmware, supply), drop it here. End.
